title: Light and Sound
seo_title: Grade 3 Science: Light and Sound Worksheets (MATATAG)
standard_code: Grade 3, Quarter 3: Force, Motion, and Energy
standard_text: Light comes from sources such as the Sun, fire and bulbs, and lets us see; some materials let light through and some block it, making shadows. Sound is made by vibrating objects and travels to our ears; sounds can be loud or soft, high or low. (summary of the MATATAG Science curriculum, Grade 3, Quarter 3: Force, Motion, and Energy)
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 Science worksheets (MATATAG, Quarter 3: Force, Motion, and Energy): sources of light, light and materials, making sound, how sound travels, and loud, soft, high and low sounds. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: We see when light enters our eyes.
key_sub: Sound is made when things vibrate.
body_html:
How to think about it

Light comes from light sources such as the Sun, a candle and a flashlight. We see objects when light bounces off them into our eyes. Transparent materials let light through; opaque materials block light and make shadows.

Sound is made when something vibrates, like a guitar string or a drum. Sound travels through air, water and solids to our ears. Sounds can be loud or soft, and high or low.

Example

Is the Moon a light source?

It reflects sunlight.

Answer: no

Example

What vibrates when you sing?

In your throat

Answer: your vocal cords

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the Moon makes its own light.
  • Thinking a loud sound is always a high sound.
  • Thinking sound can travel through empty space.
